name: WCORR-MAL-001: System executable modification → rootcheck anomaly
description: The revision prioritises more recent FIM observations, excludes the recurring /dev/null\r finding and requires a rootcheck anomaly that concerns the same executable path.
query:
sequence by agent.id.keyword with maxspan=60m
  [any where
    rule.id.keyword in ("550", "554") and
    syscheck.mode.keyword == "realtime" and
    (
      syscheck.path.keyword like "/usr/bin/*" or
      syscheck.path.keyword like "/usr/sbin/*" or
      syscheck.path.keyword like "/bin/*" or
      syscheck.path.keyword like "/sbin/*"
    )
  ] by syscheck.path.keyword
  [any where
    rule.id.keyword in ("510", "521") and
    data.file.keyword != null and
    data.file.keyword != "/dev/null\r"
  ] by data.file.keyword
author: Wazuh EQL Correlation
false_positives: Requires rootcheck to expose the same executable path in data.file.keyword; population outside the recurring anomaly is unestablished. Realtime-only FIM excludes scheduled observations and reduces coverage. Matching paths and timing do not establish malware execution.
setup: Enable realtime FIM for executable paths and establish rootcheck data.file.keyword population and exact path formatting, including carriage-return handling.
